decision: Synchronize figure policy, templates, generator and delivery checks
rationale: Explicit user feedback requires richer scientific views. Real temporal curves, additive components and conditional observations remain valid primitives within sourced diagnostics. Decorative wrapping does not qualify.

decision: Preserve formula inventory identity and native content
rationale: Accept both supported ordered Project schema identifiers with exact case, context and source hash. Use temporary text context for formula-only table cells; call Toggle TeX once and scale both object dimensions. Independent MTEF and final-page checks remain separate.

decision: Check native Office behavior in addition to ZIP/XML structure
rationale: A DOCX metadata QName can be unbound despite parseable XML. Native Word open/reopen and PowerPoint chart hosting expose compatibility issues. Verify edits before restoring the whole disposable PPT copy, keeping cached chart data and workbook consistent.

decision: Use UTF-8 maintenance output and verify native formula changes
rationale: Chinese feedback must survive a legacy Windows console and return valid UTF-8 JSON. Formula changes require actual saved MTEF differences, not editor activation or typed text alone.
